title: Grateful Dead Live at Community Concourse on 1970-01-10
lineage: RX (purported 2nd gen) > Technics RS-1506 > Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] > Korg MR-1000 > DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] > Korg AudioGate > wav [24/96]

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture with fierce China and a standout Mason's Children, showcasing a tight early‑70 performance.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear sound quality of this SirMick soundboard tape, calling it "great" and praising the band for being fully "on". Musically the show is highlighted by an incendiary rendition of China and a powerful Mason's Children, though one reviewer notes the songs are unusually brief and the concert isn’t essential for the tour overall.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical highlights (China, Mason's Children) plus consistently high praise for recording quality push the rating above average; limited number of reviews keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as "great" and "crisp" with no noted issues; source is a dedicated SBD (SirMick) capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Songs are notably brief, which some find refreshing while others see it as non‑essential; overall a solid early‑70 set that feels tight and energetic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His playing is singled out as "fierce" on China and generally praised throughout.
